root_cause.consequence: No per-model cell_state_mapping capability row exists to carry a native-task disposition, so the disposition is recorded here instead. Adding rows to the capability registry is a separate, non-additive change and is deliberately not attempted.
root_cause.finding: config/evaluation/cell_state_mapping_capabilities.toml carries no [[models]] roster. It is 12 lines of task-level scope with four family names, a baseline list and an ATAC-only exclusion, and it names no per-model row. config/evaluation/variant_to_regulation_capabilities.toml carries 40 per-model rows over 411 lines. That structural asymmetry, not a missing judgement, is why the cell_state_mapping native-task column is empty for every family in this record.
